jobs:
  validate-config-crud:
    name: Validate Config CRUD
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    services:
      vault:
        image: hashicorp/vault:2.0.1
        options: >-
          --name=vault
          --cap-add=IPC_LOCK
        env:
          VAULT_DEV_ROOT_TOKEN_ID: 227e1cce-6bf7-30bb-2d2a-acc854318caf
        ports:
          - 8200:8200

    env:
      VAULT_ADDR: http://0.0.0.0:8200
      VAULT_TOKEN: 227e1cce-6bf7-30bb-2d2a-acc854318caf
      VAULT_LOG_FILE: vault.log
      BANK_VAULTS_LOG_FILE: bank-vaults.log
      BANK_VAULTS_CONFIG_FILE: /tmp/vault-config.yaml

      # The input value changes according to the workflow context.
      LOG_LEVEL: "${{ github.event.inputs.log-level || inputs.log-level }}"

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

      - name: Install Dependencies
        run: |
          wget -O - https://apt.releases.hashicorp.com/gpg | sudo gpg --dearmor -o /usr/share/keyrings/hashicorp-archive-keyring.gpg
          echo "deb [arch=$(dpkg --print-architecture) signed-by=/usr/share/keyrings/hashicorp-archive-keyring.gpg] https://apt.releases.hashicorp.com $(lsb_release -cs) main" | sudo tee /etc/apt/sources.list.d/hashicorp.list
          sudo apt update && sudo apt install vault
          sudo wget https://github.com/mikefarah/yq/releases/latest/download/yq_linux_amd64 -O /usr/local/bin/yq
          sudo chmod +x /usr/local/bin/yq

      - name: Build Bank-vaults
        run: |
          make build
          echo "${{ github.workspace }}/build" >> $GITHUB_PATH

      - name: Run bank-vaults
        run: |
          touch "${{ env.BANK_VAULTS_CONFIG_FILE }}"
          bank-vaults configure \
            --mode dev \
            --vault-config-file "${{ env.BANK_VAULTS_CONFIG_FILE }}" \
            &> "${{ env.BANK_VAULTS_LOG_FILE }}" & disown

      - name: Test group - Audit
        if: always()

        run: bash e2e/validate-config-crud/test.sh "auth"

        run: bash e2e/validate-config-crud/test.sh "groups"

      - name: Test group - Secrets
        if: always()
        run: bash e2e/validate-config-crud/test.sh "secrets"

name: Checks

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  pull_request:

jobs:
  checks:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      # submodules: the SoloPlay submodule cannot be checked in isolation (its tsconfig points at
      # ../../sdk and ../../libs), so the parent checkout is where it gets validated - against the
      # exact commit this repo pins.
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          submodules: recursive

      # Node 24: eslint-plugin-es-x@10 requires ^22.23.0 || ^24.18.0 || >=26.4.0, and
      # eslint@10 requires ^20.19.0 || ^22.13.0 || >=24. Anything older cannot run the toolchain.
      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: '24'
          cache: npm

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      # lint:check, never `lint` - that one is `eslint --fix`, which would rewrite files in CI
      # and let anything auto-fixable pass silently.
      - name: ESLint
        run: npm run lint:check

      - name: Typecheck
        run: npm run typecheck

      # The no-undef inventory is generated. If someone adds a global without regenerating,
      # the committed file goes stale and no-undef quietly stops covering it.
      - name: Globals inventory is current
        run: npm run globals:check

      - name: Typecheck (SoloPlay submodule)
        run: npm run typecheck:soloplay

      # Every runtime .js must belong to a TS program. A file in none gets no typechecking and
      # no editor intellisense, and nothing else reports it.
      - name: No orphaned files
        run: node tools/audit/program-files.mjs --check
